_comment: External MCP servers for Mission Barisal. Every entry is loopback-bound. Ports are ${VAR} placeholders resolved from .env by lib/expand-env.js — change the port in .env, never here, or the spawner will pin a stale value.
_security: 2026-10-08: removed hardcoded remote DNS entry https://api.zombiecoder.my.id/mcp (was name:zombiecoder, autoConnect:true). All remaining servers are loopback-bound (127.0.0.1).

servers.name: ocr
servers.note: OCR tool — image text extraction via Tesseract.

servers.name: screen-recorder
servers.note: Screen recorder — screenshot + video recording via ffmpeg.

servers.name: tts
servers.note: TTS — text to speech (Edge TTS) + playback via ffplay.

servers.name: facebook-ads
servers.note: Facebook Ads — 29 tools. Needs FB credentials; left disabled until configured.

servers.name: combined
servers.note: Gateway merging facebook-ads + public-api behind one port — 71 tools.

servers.name: universal-adapter
servers.note: Universal transport adapter — HTTP + HTTPS + stdio. Serves its own 9 sandboxed tools plus 145 pulled from the main server (see universal-adapter/main-sync.js).
